sections.heading: Section 1: Angle Sum, Difference & Double-Angle Formulas

questions.q: If $\sin \theta = \frac{3}{5}$ and $\theta$ is in Quadrant II, what is the exact value of $\sin(2\theta)$?
What is the exact value of $\cos(75^\circ)$ using the angle sum formula $\cos(45^\circ + 30^\circ)$?
Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{1 - \cos(2x)}{2}$?
questions.answer: This is the standard power-reducing identity: $\sin^2 x = \frac{1 - \cos(2x)}{2}$.

questions.q: Solve the equation $2\sin^2 x - 3\sin x + 1 = 0$ for all solutions in the interval $[0, 2\pi)$.
questions.answer: Factor: $(2\sin x - 1)(\sin x - 1) = 0$. Thus $\sin x = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow x = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}$, or $\sin x = 1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{\pi}{2}$.

questions.q: How many solutions does the equation $\cos(2x) = 0$ have in the closed interval $[0, 2\pi]$?
questions.answer: For $x \in [0, 2\pi]$, $2x \in [0, 4\pi]$. $\cos(2x) = 0$ when $2x = \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{2}, \frac{7\pi}{2}$. Dividing by $2$ yields $4$ distinct solutions.

questions.q: What is the exact value of $\sin(\arccos(-\frac{1}{2}))$?

questions.answer: Let $\theta = \arcsin(5/13)$, so opposite $= 5$, hypotenuse $= 13$, adjacent $= \sqrt{13^2 - 5^2} = 12$. Therefore, $\tan\theta = \frac{5}{12}$.

questions.q: What is the range of the principal inverse tangent function $f(x) = \arctan(x)$?
questions.answer: The standard range of $\arctan(x)$ is the open interval $(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2})$.

sections.heading: Section 4: Law of Tangents & Polar Trigonometry

questions.answer: By standard cosine subtraction theorem: $\cos(A - B) = \cos A \cos B + \sin A \sin B$.

questions.q: In $\triangle ABC$, $a = 7$, $b = 5$, and $c = 8$. What is $\cos B$?
What is the maximum value of the function $f(x) = 3\sin x - 4\cos x$?
questions.answer: Using the linear combination harmonic form $A\sin x + B\cos x = R\sin(x + \phi)$, the amplitude is $R = \sqrt{3^2 + (-4)^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5$.
